_comment: A card that exists only for tests/unit/test_playable_while_exiled.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_brain_impulse` is Elder Brain's permission clock on an impulse draw: play the exiled card for as long as it remains exiled.

cards.name: Test Brain Impulse
cards.oracle_text: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card for as long as it remains exiled.
